chunks: My father (peace be upon him) narrated from Abdullah ibn Ja'far from Harun ibn Muslim from Mas'adah ibn Sadqah from Ja'far al-Sadiq from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Fortunate is he who finds in his record on the Day of Judgment, under every sin, [the words] 'I seek forgiveness from Allah'.'
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for being considered fortunate on the Day of Judgment according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from the Thawab al-A'mal, transmitted through the Imams, emphasizes the efficacy of consistent istighfar in mitigating individual sins on the Day of Judgment. It reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that sincere repentance acts as a spiritual eraser, ensuring that each transgression is individually covered by divine mercy rather than accumulating as a burden. This underscores the practical importance of maintaining a habit of seeking forgiveness after every deed, big or small.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 5.  Imam  Muhammad  (a.s.)  narrates  that  the  Holy  Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, “One who has Astaghfirullaah written under each  of his sin on the Day of Judgment is indeed fortunate.”
